To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a static taint analysis for the Android OS that is precise with respect to context, flow, object and field sensitivity, as well as with respect to the lifecycle of Android apps, that we have implemented this analysis as the FlowDroid tool, and that FlowDroid outperforms the existing static analysis tools for Android in terms of precision, recall, and scalability.
FlowDroid is the first context-, flow-, field-, and object-sensitive and lifecycle- aware taint-analysis tool for Android apps that can be used to find data leaks and security violations.
FlowDroid is a context-, flow-, field-, object-, and lifecycle-aware tained analysis for Android apps that is more precise than existing approaches, yet still scales to large real-life apps.

it is possible to perform precise taint analysis for a realistic and large set of Android apps, without compromising on performance.

a static taint analysis of Android apps can be precise enough to be used as an effective tool in app-store vetting, while being efficient enough to be applied to the large number of apps in the Google Play store.
